results.notes: Used row swaps and elimination to reduce to 4x4 determinant. Computed via cofactor expansion and confirmed arithmetic.

Used Gaussian elimination with integer row operations and tracking scaling factors. After reducing to block triangular form, computed determinant of 3x3 submatrix as -146, leading to final determinant 1168.

Computed determinant via row reduction and cofactor expansion. Swapped rows to get pivot, eliminated column1, then reduced 5x5 minor using expansion along a row with a zero, computing four 4x4 determinants. Result: 2804.

Computed determinant using row reduction: first eliminated column1 of original 6x6 to get 5x5 submatrix, then continued elimination with rational arithmetic, clearing denominators to get integer determinant, finally obtained 1248.
Computed via Gaussian elimination with one row swap and back substitution; product of pivots gave -7050.
Expanded along first row (2 and -3). Computed 5x5 minors via cofactor expansions (column4) and 4x4 determinants via row operations/expansions, yielding 2*1638 + 3*453 = 4635.
Computed via row swap and Gaussian elimination to a 5x5, then cofactor expansion to 4x4, then cofactor to 3x3s. Verified arithmetic. Determinant = -816.

Swapped rows 1 and 4 (sign change), eliminated first column using pivot 1, then computed determinant of 5×5 submatrix via expansion after fraction-free elimination, yielding -636; original determinant = -(-636)=636.
Expanded along row6 (many zeros) to get -3*M62 + 2*M65. Computed M62 via expansion along column4, got 1382. Computed M65 via row operations, got 281. Result -3584.
Expanded along column 1 (three zeros), computed three 5x5 minors using cofactor expansions and row operations, got det = -1300.
